facts.value: To apply for federal financial aid, complete a Free Application for Federal Student Aid.

View your FAFSA information on your Finances tab in My ASU, and view your Priority Tasks for important financial aid next steps. Complete any items listed under Priority Tasks early to ensure you do not have any barriers to receiving your aid.
Arizona law requires verification of citizenship or other lawful presence in the U.S. for all students receiving financial aid funded by state money.
We encourage you to compare financial aid and college costs.
